# GFx golden reference set — retail movie feature inventory

**Generated by** `mercs2_formats/src/bin/gfx_golden.rs` from **83** movies under `output/gfx_movies` (83 parsed). This is the authoritative record of which SWF/GFx features the shipping Mercenaries 2 (**Scaleform GFx 2.0.48 / AVM1**) movies actually use — the golden set a community authoring tool ([`gfxforge`](../../tools/mercs2-tools-gfxforge/)) validates against. Each feature below names the real movie to byte-diff a new emitter against.

> Method: parse the container (CFX=zlib) + top-level tag stream exactly; parse shape bodies as far as the fill-style array (enough to flag gradient/bitmap fills). Nothing about the GFx tag set is assumed — the tables are discovered from the movies. See the companion spec `gfx_authoring_feature_spec.md` for the encodings.
